title: 764. Prime Number of Set Bits in Binary Representation

examples.explanation: Only 15 (4 bits) misses a prime count.
A single one-bit is not prime.

hints: Count one-bits with a loop or a builtin popcount, then test membership in the small prime set.
Values up to 10^6 need at most 20 bits, so only primes 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19 can occur.
